entry.title: JE-8086 0.1.1
entry.summary: JE-8086 for MPC 0.1.1: a Roland JP-8000 emulation (gearmulator) for MPC Gen2 devices (MPC Live III and other aarch64 MPCs) on MPC OS 3.10 or later. Changes since 0.1.0: - The emulator now runs on the fast cores of big.LITTLE CPUs. On an MPC Live III that's about 25% less CPU (cores 4-6). - It runs further ahead for a moment when a sound loads or the program changes, to avoid dropouts while the emulator catches up. - When dropouts happen, it writes a diagnostic line to MPC's log (`journalctl -u a
